AP-all-0004/A1.title: Every close row and scoreboard line carries the serving model, read from its work commit's Co-Authored-By trailer
AP-all-0004/A1.done_when: the house's newest close row carries the model its work commit's trailer names, and its figures are reported per model; negative control: a work commit with no model trailer reads the model UNMEASURED, never a guess

AP-all-0006/A1.title: Binaries go to Git LFS by the atlas's set, text never, with LF line endings for text; sealed and data paths keep their bytes
AP-all-0006/A1.done_when: git check-attr filter reads lfs for x.png, x.wav, x.mp4, x.pdf, x.zip and x.glb and unspecified for x.md, x.json and x.svg; negative control: a .md file never reads lfs, and a .png staged with git add is stored as an LFS pointer

AP-all-0006/A2.title: The ignore file carries the caches and mirrors the house's never-store list (IR-13)
AP-all-0006/A2.done_when: git check-ignore matches x/__pycache__/a.pyc, .venv/a and a/.DS_Store, and a/SubstrateSoulData/b and a/.env where the house mirrors the atlas's list; negative control: SUBSTRATE.md or README.md is not ignored

AP-all-0006/A3.title: Byte-exact test vectors stay in plain git, marked binary, never LFS (Kernel's vectors/**/*.bin); a house with none answers not applicable
AP-all-0006/A3.done_when: git check-attr -a reads diff, merge and text unset and no filter for vectors/loads/9.bin; negative control: HEAD:vectors/loads/9.bin is not an LFS pointer
AP-all-0006/A3.reason: not applicable: the house has no byte-exact test vectors (AP-review-0002, A6)

AP-all-0007/A1.title: The reply writer accepts not-applicable, which must name its item; nothing else changes
AP-all-0007/A1.done_when: write(..., kind='not-applicable', item='A3') appends a reply with that kind and item, and the house check is green; negative control: the same call with no item writes nothing and says why, and an unknown kind is still refused

AP-all-0009/A1.title: The reply writer accepts reading; it is not in WAITS; nothing else changes
AP-all-0009/A1.done_when: write(..., kind='reading', item='A3') appends a reply with that kind and item, and the house check is green; negative control: an unknown kind is still refused with nothing written, and with reading removed from KINDS the call is refused and the house's test fails

AP-review-0002/A1.title: IR-13's concurrency guards and the banned-address check in house/, ported from Jetsam's house/ and re-derived; the check reads the atlas's fingerprint list and the house commits none (AT.765); one house check
AP-review-0002/A1.done_when: bash tools/check.sh --atlas <atlas> reports zero findings on the house's own tree and every test passes; no tracked file or commit of the house holds any fingerprint of the atlas's ops/banned-authors.yaml; negative control: a fixture commit by a made-up address whose fingerprint a test plants turns the banned check red with neither the address nor the full fingerprint printed

AP-review-0002/A2.title: The creation log house/branches.jsonl, written by house/branch.sh as each branch's first commit and seeded with review-T1's branch
AP-review-0002/A2.done_when: a branch made by the tool carries its creation line in its first commit, the log names session/2026-11-10/01-review-t1-setup as Claude's and merged, and both kinds of duplicate are refused

AP-review-0002/A3.title: house/unmerged.py: the unmerged check, the ready gate (IR-16), merges by pull request on DU's word with the banned-address reading before and after, and pruning; ops/branch-policy.yaml
AP-review-0002/A3.done_when: an in-progress branch is never offered, an unmarked one of Claude's is refused by merge with nothing pushed, a ready one lands by pull request at the tip DU was shown, a planted fingerprint for a stubbed committer refuses the merge with no merge call made, and pruning keeps the newest ten

AP-review-0002/A4.title: The queue pull at boot and close: each new item filed once in WORK.md's atlas items, top items offered by widget, state in house/atlas-queue.json
AP-review-0002/A4.done_when: the first pull records every open queue item against its key in house/atlas-queue.json, filing none twice, and the atlas's tools/atlasqueue.py status reads the file at the house's main; negative control: an unreachable atlas reads UNREACHABLE and leaves the state file untouched

AP-review-0002/A6.title: The skeleton: the atlas's LFS block and LF endings in .gitattributes, the caches in .gitignore, and the verify workflow running the kit's tests
AP-review-0002/A6.done_when: git check-attr filter reads lfs for x.png, x.wav, x.mp4, x.pdf, x.zip and x.glb and unspecified for x.md, x.json and x.svg; git check-ignore matches the caches and a never-store path; the verify workflow runs bash tools/check.sh green on the delivery's pull request

AP-review-0002/A7.title: HANDOFF.md's gap closed and its live state corrected from RC-review-T1, the boot's self-check against its registry row and gate (IR-17, IR-18), BOOT_PROMPT.md, review-T1 marked landed in WORK.md, and the trains' receipt lines in SUBSTRATE.md
AP-review-0002/A7.done_when: HANDOFF.md names no missing guard, BOOT_PROMPT.md starts with Rule 0 verbatim and names the boot with the self-check, the emitter given the house's SUBSTRATE.md with --from reproduces it byte for byte, and the house check is green; negative control: a registry row edited to another stage in a test copy of the atlas is named as a difference by the self-check

AP-all-0002/A2.title: Send replies to the atlas (house/atlas-replies.jsonl, contract atlas-reply), an arrival at each prompt's first filing, and show the atlas's answers at boot
AP-all-0002/A2.done_when: the atlas's tools/atlasreply.py read --record records the house's arrival for AP-all-0002 with no refusal, and the house's next boot shows the atlas's confirmation

AP-all-0003/A2.title: Port the ready gate into the house's own branch tools (ready, review, brief, the gate in merge, ops/branch-policy.yaml) and mark ready as the close's last act
AP-all-0003/A2.done_when: in the house, a branch of Claude's with no ready mark is refused by merge with nothing pushed, and the same branch merges once marked ready

AP-all-0004/A2.title: A defect found by a new red check names the change that introduced it; a boot disagreement names the close that wrote the claim
AP-all-0004/A2.done_when: a defect the house finds with a new check records its introducing commit (or UNMEASURED with why), found by bisecting the house's history; negative control: a check that fails at every commit of the range reports the defect older than the range, never the range's first commit

AP-all-0004/A3.title: Boot reads the atlas's host facts for its surface and harness, and replies with what it measured anew
AP-all-0004/A3.done_when: the house's boot report names the facts the atlas's ops/host-facts.jsonl holds for its surface and harness, and a fact it measures anew or finds contradicted reaches the atlas as a reply (B18); negative control: a fact recorded on another surface or harness version is never reported as known

AP-all-0004/A4.title: Where the house has an act gate: each block is logged with the operator's answer, and each rule's confirm rate and misses print at review
AP-all-0004/A4.done_when: the act gate's log carries the operator's answer for every block, and review prints each rule's confirm rate and misses; negative control: a rule with no answer on record reads UNMEASURED, never a perfect rate; a rule changes only by the operator's ruling. A house with no act gate replies not applicable

AP-all-0004/A5.title: Every pre-registered run in the house states its decision rule
AP-all-0004/A5.done_when: each run the house pre-registers names, for each outcome band, which default changes or which proposal advances; negative control: a run filed without one is refused by the house's check. A house that pre-registers no run replies not applicable

AP-all-0005/A1.title: Boot and handoff prompts versioned and each boot scored against its version; revisions under the membrane-shaping contract
AP-all-0005/A1.done_when: each boot report names its prompt's version and its score (corrections, recall level where a soul boots, turns to the first correct act), and a revision carries the shaping contract's provenance line and evaluation record; negative control: a boot report naming no version is refused, and a prompt whose Rule 0 line differs from the canonical text fails its digest check

AP-all-0008/A1.title: The banned-address check and its fingerprint list, re-derived from the atlas's tools/authors.py: fingerprints only, each house's own since, never an address; a public house commits no fingerprint and reads the atlas's list (AT.765)
AP-all-0008/A1.done_when: check on the house's main prints the fingerprint count, the commits read since since and 0 banned, and the house's fingerprints equal the atlas's ops/banned-authors.yaml at the atlas commit read; negative control: a fixture commit by a made-up address whose fingerprint is planted in a test list turns the check red (exit 1), with neither the address nor its full fingerprint in the output

AP-all-0008/A2.title: The house's merge tool refuses before landing on a match (the branch's commits, git user.email) and prints STOP after GitHub's merge when the merge commit matches
AP-all-0008/A2.done_when: a merge on DU's word through the house's tool prints its before and after readings, both clean; negative control: with a fingerprint planted for a stubbed committer the tool refuses with nothing merged and the stubbed API records no merge call, and a stubbed merge commit by that address prints STOP and exits non-zero

AP-all-0008/A3.title: Boot prints the banned-address line and the list's drift against the atlas's; the first clean reading goes to the atlas as a reply (IR-15)
AP-all-0008/A3.done_when: the house's boot prints fingerprints, commits read, banned count and whether its list equals the atlas's at its main, and its reply of kind reading (a question before AP-all-0009/A1; A3's words amended by AT.684) carries its first clean reading; negative control: a list one fingerprint short reads DRIFT, and an unreachable atlas reads UNREACHABLE with the boot green, never a match

AP-review-0002/A5.title: Replies to the atlas in house/atlas-replies.jsonl (IR-15): an arrival at each prompt's first take-in, the other kinds by command, the answers shown at boot
AP-review-0002/A5.done_when: the atlas's tools/atlasreply.py read records the house's arrivals with no refusal, and the next boot shows the atlas's confirmations

AP-all-0004/A6.title: The house's suite records failures against the files a change touched and offers a precheck ordered likeliest-to-fail first
AP-all-0004/A6.done_when: after a planted failure history, the precheck runs first the test that failed after a change to the same file and stops at its red; negative control: with no history the order is the suite's own, and the full suite still runs before every merge

AP-all-0005/A2.title: Gates record when they last fired; one idle past a horizon gets a sabotage run, then goes to the operator
AP-all-0005/A2.done_when: each gate's last real firing is on record and an idle gate is put to the operator after a sabotage run; negative control: a silent gate that fails its sabotage run is reported broken, never offered for retirement
